preconditions.description: The board dimensions n and m are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(row in {'.', 'w', 'b'} for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the board is either '.', 'w', or 'b'.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row in the board has exactly m columns.

postconditions.description: The output starts with 'YES' if a tiling exists, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(row in {'.', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd'} for row in tiling) if tiling_exists else True
postconditions.description: If a tiling exists, each cell in the tiling is either '.', 'a', 'b', 'c', or 'd'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in tiling) if tiling_exists else True
postconditions.description: If a tiling exists, each row in the tiling has exactly m columns.

postconditions.expression: all(tiling[i][j] == board[i][j] or board[i][j] == '.' for i in range(n) for j in range(m)) if tiling_exists else True
postconditions.description: If a tiling exists, each cell in the tiling matches the corresponding cell in the board or is a cut-out square.

postconditions.expression: all(tiling[i][j] != tiling[i+1][j] and tiling[i][j] != tiling[i][j+1] for i in range(n-1) for j in range(m-1) if tiling[i][j] in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd'}) if tiling_exists else True
postconditions.description: If a tiling exists, adjacent triminoes are denoted by different symbols.
